app.name: Lumen
app.tagline: Keep awake while your agents are working.
notify.lidDeclined.title: Lumen
notify.lidDeclined.body: Lid-close policy needs administrator approval. Keeping awake via away-mode only (closing the lid may still sleep).
notify.lidFailed.title: Lumen
notify.lidFailed.body: Could not change the lid-close policy. Keeping awake via away-mode only.
settings.title: Lumen Settings
settings.general.manageLid.hint: Sets the lid-close action to "Do nothing" while keeping awake, and restores it afterwards. Requires a one-time UAC prompt.
settings.triggers.processList.hint: Executable names without extension, e.g. ollama, docker, node, python.
settings.safety.batteryFloor: Battery floor — allow sleep at or below (percent)
settings.safety.criticalBattery: Critical battery — force sleep at or below (percent)
settings.safety.maxHours: Hard cap on continuous awake (hours, 0 = none)
settings.safety.acOnly: Only keep awake on AC power
settings.safety.hint: Safety governors can only allow sleep — they never override a low battery.
settings.about.description: Lumen keeps your laptop awake with the lid closed, but only while your AI coding agents are actually working. When the work stops, it lets the machine sleep again.
